meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会按指南排查容器代理故障：检查主机与容器日志、查看两个会话数据库中的消息流，并针对容器启动失败、认证错误、挂载问题等给出诊断和修复步骤。
howto.when: 当容器出现故障（如启动失败、无响应）、认证报错，或你想了解容器系统的运作方式时触发。

say.text: 容器启动后立即退出且无回复，请帮我查看日志和会话数据库。
say.note: 按流程检查错误日志和两个会话数据库，定位失败原因。

say.text: 消息已标记为送达但用户没收到，可能是什么问题？
say.note: 会检查是否有重复的服务实例导致消息被标记为已送达但未发送。

say.text: 把日志级别设为debug，我要查看容器的stderr。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can debug containerized agent issues: inspect host/container logs, query the two session DBs for message flow, and diagnose startup failures, auth errors, mount problems, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when containers misbehave (startup failures, no responses), when authentication errors occur, or when you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: My container exits immediately with no reply. Please check logs and session DBs.
say_en.note: Walks through error logs and inbound/outbound DBs.

say_en.text: Messages are marked delivered but the user never received them. What's wrong?
say_en.note: Looks for duplicate instances that drop deliveries.

say_en.text: Set log level to debug so I can see container stderr.
say_en.note: Streams container stderr into host log at debug level.
